asOfNoteZh: 口径快照约2026年3月前后；福布斯与胡润算法不同，不可简单相加当唯一真理。
asOfNoteEn: Snapshot around March 2026; Forbes and Hurun methodologies differ—do not naively add them into one “truth” total.

under30.noteZh: 福布斯：全球未满30岁、个人身价≥约10亿美元且上榜者共35人。
under30.noteEn: Forbes: 35 people under 30 with published ~USD 1B+ fortunes on the World’s Billionaires list.

under40SelfMadeOnly.noteZh: 胡润：全球40岁及以下「白手起家」美元亿万富豪108人（不含继承人专榜）。
under40SelfMadeOnly.noteEn: Hurun: 108 self-made USD billionaires aged 40 & under (this Hurun sublist does not rank heirs).

under40AllIncludingHeirs.noteZh: 目前没有一份与福布斯under-30同样干净的「全球U40含继承人」官方总人数头条；保守下界≈胡润白手108 + 福布斯under-30继承人23，再加30–40岁继承人（未汇总）。
under40AllIncludingHeirs.noteEn: No single clean Forbes-style headline total for all U40 billionaires including heirs; a conservative floor is Hurun’s 108 self-made plus Forbes’ 23 under-30 heirs, plus uncounted heirs aged 30–40.

productRuleZh: 本站主口径改为U40：创业榜/观察名单可以不是亿万富翁（如上市前的王兴兴）；富豪榜只收有公开身价者。来源含福布斯、胡润及其他权威披露。
productRuleEn: Product rule is now U40: founder/watch boards may be non-billionaires (e.g. Wang Xingxing before IPO); wealth boards require published net worth. Sources include Forbes, Hurun, and other authoritative disclosures.
